notes: Founder: Maya Liu (ex-mobile PM), 5 engineers, early revenue, runway-sensitive.
Primary ask: simple, predictable pricing + scale path. 'If it's not cheaper than OpenAI for embeddings at volume, we can't switch.'
Workload profile: mix of short chat messages (avg 20 tokens), occasional long context retrieval for support (avg 1200 tokens), embeddings index ~50k docs initially.
Latency targets: user-facing chat <250ms median for token generation; embeddings async OK but developer wants <500ms for single embed call.
Throughput: currently low (burst to ~10rps during launches). Expects growth to ~50qps during peak within 6 months.
Cost sensitivity: high. Wants a sample cost sheet showing per-1M token cost across small/medium/large model tiers and an embeddings per-1M-vector cost line vs OpenAI/Anthropic.
Security: SOC2 is a nice-to-have; must-have is audit logs and single-tenant visibility into API keys usage. Data residency: US preferred for user data.
Integration notes: front-end uses Firebase, backend node microservices. Wants an SDK example or curl snippet she can paste into existing signup flow.
Questions raised: refund/overage policy, quota controls, rate-limiting guidance, trial credits extension process.
Founder quote on call: 'We need a one-pager we can show to the board that says how much we'll pay compared to OpenAI and how latency looks in production.'

Competitive considerations: founder ran quick benchmarks vs OpenAI's ada/curie embeddings — cost looked about 20% cheaper on our sample but worried about quality tradeoffs. Mentioned Anthropic for chat safety and model behavior.
Technical ask to SE: example cost calc for 1M chat messages (20 tokens/message), 1M embeddings, and a mixed scenario with caching (prefix caching assumptions).
Internal: AE flagged as early, low-touch. Offer: push self-serve hosted trials + pre-baked pricing comparison deck. Consider small committed credit promo to lock initial usage.
